title: The Most Useless RP
description: This resource pack was originally made for personal use, but you can still download it if you want, it mainly changes small visual and UI things, and you might end up liking it... (probably not though)
body:
A really simple "vanilla styled" resource pack that "improves" the HUD.

This RP was originally made for personal use, however, feel free to download it if you want. Theres a list below explaining some reasons why you might want to use this pack.

> Stuff:
1. Roman numerals replaced with Arabic numerals (1, 2, 3...)
2. Numbered hotbar
3. Cleaner circular block breaking texture
4. Dot crosshair
5. Custom 3D Totem based on my skin (cuz why not? Its an personal RP after all)
